title: UI风格#119 - Swiss International (瑞士国际风格)
description: 创建第119种UI风格：瑞士国际风格 - 现代主义、网格系统、无衬线字体。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDO.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss International style When color palette Then features jet black, pure white, signal red, neutral gray
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#000000 (纯黑), #FFFFFF (纯白), #FF0000 (信号红), #808080 (中性灰), #F5F5F5 (浅灰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss International style When typography Then uses swiss sans: Akzidenz Grotesk, Helvetica, or Univers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Akzidenz Grotesk (标题), Helvetica (正文), Univers (数字)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss International style When layout Then strict baseline grid, objective photography, flush left type
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：严格基线网格、客观摄影、左对齐文字

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss International style When UI elements Then mathematical spacing, clear hierarchy, objective tone
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：数学间距、清晰层次、客观语调、精确对齐

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss International UI When functional Then includes systematic chat, swiss agents, grid stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：系统化聊天、瑞士代理、网格统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Swiss International UI When copy Then uses modernist: 'System', 'Order', 'Hierarchy', 'Clarity'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SYSTEM. ORDER. HIERARCHY.'、按钮'SEND'→'FORMAT'、'SUBMIT'→'ALIGN'
